subject: english
stem:
Although the first test failed, the team learned why and built a working model the next week.
Which statement best covers the whole paragraph?
options: The team stopped after one test
The team used failure to reach a working result

optionRationales.reason: Failure always guarantees success：原文還有 learned why 與 rebuilt，非自動保證。
The team stopped after one test：與 built a working model 相反。
The team used failure to reach a working result：although 將失敗設為背景，主要句強調學習與成功。
The first test failed：只抓讓步背景。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「轉折標記後的修正、限制或作者真正採納的立場」可推出 The team used failure to reach a working result；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The team used failure to reach a working result 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
